pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly shaped polygons with predominantly rounded edges and smooth pixel gradients. Patch density is higher on the lower flank with smaller, more circular geometries, transitioning to larger, more elongated shapes on the upper shoulder and neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored pathways forming a complex topological graph. Intersections primarily consist of three-way and four-way nodes with variable pixel thickness ranging from narrow channels to wider junctions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, low-amplitude serrated profile visible along the neck and shoulder, representing a short, dense mane with a high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background.
